definition: the trouble taste gave me as a child, and how little of it is left

settled:
Taste was a major problem when I was a child. I would find a safe food and eat it continuously for months.

I still do some of that. But I can also eat at a restaurant normally now, and taste is much less of an issue than it was.

The one exception that has held is anything smoke-flavoured.

title: What Taste Used To Do To Me
